raw.question: Use the OSS Go durable-local server as the executable reference oracle and keep Cloudflare/Terse as public-edge black-box targets behind one control adapter contract
raw.chosen: Use the OSS Go durable-local server as the executable reference oracle and keep Cloudflare/Terse as public-edge black-box targets behind one control adapter contract
raw.reasoning: The public repository contains no Cloudflare Durable Object implementation; backend internals are neither available nor a portable contract. Public HTTP/WebSocket behavior plus explicit fault, clock, lifecycle, migration, and mount hooks keeps the gate backend-neutral.

raw.question: Exclude tester-army/e2e from deterministic conformance gates
raw.chosen: Exclude tester-army/e2e from deterministic conformance gates

alternatives.option: Add an optional dashboard smoke now

raw.reasoning: Pinned tester-army/e2e is model-driven browser/mobile record-replay, has no API contract focus, enables telemetry by default, and is pre-1.0. It does not improve the required HTTP/WebSocket/runtime invariants; an optional dashboard smoke can be reconsidered later with telemetry disabled.

raw.reasoning: Status-only assertions miss shape drift. Runtime validation found an invalid allOf/additionalProperties composition in conflict schemas, which is now represented as explicit response schemas.

events.content: The core harness now passes the Go oracle except for one receipt assertion that exposed intentional correlation/written-count differences; the invariant was narrowed to stable opId and revision. Advanced runtime cases are adapter-gated and full profiles convert every missing capability into a failure.

raw.adjustments: Document precise control request/response shapes; finish target schema and CI evidence upload; rerun all required gates before reviewer handoff.

events.content: Use an out-of-band state.inspect control operation as the post-clock proof point: Use an out-of-band state.inspect control operation as the post-clock proof point

raw.question: Use an out-of-band state.inspect control operation as the post-clock proof point
raw.chosen: Use an out-of-band state.inspect control operation as the post-clock proof point

alternatives.option: Use provider.calls for every state type

raw.reasoning: Polling the public API can wake an actor and mask a missing alarm/scheduler. state.inspect is required to read durable backing state without gateway or actor invocation before any public verification.

events.content: Exact-head review found false-pass topology in pagination, poison HOL, timer wakeups, reconnect, and socket-effect limit cases. The remediation now pages the full feed, proves HOL before retry exhaustion, inspects state out-of-band after clock advance, disconnects before reconnect backlog, holds a live socket through eviction, and subscribes during the 513-event bulk.

raw.adjustments: Run consolidated local gate; wait for the replacement head CI to finish before requesting the next exact-head verdict.
